findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: notes_post, call_rpc, get_operator · Private data: audit_funders, audit_cluster, notes_sign, notes_read, sample_rpc, buy_time, get_payment_terms · Public sink: notes_sign, notes_post, call_rpc · Destructive: notes_post, buy_time.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: notes_post, call_rpc, get_operator · Private data: audit_funders, audit_cluster, notes_sign, notes_read, sample_rpc, buy_time, get_payment_terms · Public sink: notes_sign, notes_post, call_rpc · Destructive: notes_post, buy_time

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
